requirements.reachable: Every device in “{{from}}” can reach every device in “{{to}}”.
requirements.notReachable: No device in “{{from}}” can reach a device in “{{to}}”, and both stay online.
requirements.internet: Every device in “{{group}}” has internet access.
requirements.dhcpServes: Every device in “{{group}}” gets its address automatically (DHCP).
requirements.sameVlan: All devices in “{{group}}” are in the same network segment (VLAN).
requirements.addressPlan: Every device in “{{group}}” uses an address in {{prefix}}.
requirements.maxCost: The added equipment costs at most {{amount, number}} units.

maxDevices.other: Added devices of type {{kind}}: at most {{count}}.

uses.other: The design includes a device with the capability “{{capability}}”.
uses.routing: The design includes a router (routing between networks).
uses.l3Switching: The design includes a layer 3 switch.
uses.wireless: The design includes Wi-Fi (an access point or a wireless router).
uses.wirelessClient: The design includes a Wi-Fi client device.
uses.dhcpServer: The design includes a device that can run a DHCP server.
uses.dnsServer: The design includes a device that can run a DNS server.
uses.poe: The design includes PoE switching (power over the network cable).
uses.hostTerminal: The design includes a device with a command prompt.
uses.deviceCli: The design includes a managed network device (CLI).
uses.appLinks: The design includes a device that uses applications on other devices.
uses.internetService: The design includes an internet connection.

landing.title: Design a network for a customer
landing.text: A customer describes what they need; you pick the equipment, cable it, configure it and prove every requirement, with a budget like a real quotation.

list.title: Design tasks
list.lead: A customer tells you what their network has to do. Their devices are already in place; you add switches, routers, access points and cables, set up addressing and services and stay within the budget. The checklist turns green as your design meets each requirement.
list.hint: Every task ends with a design review: score, quotation, weak points and a reference design.

state.submitted: Submitted, not every requirement met yet

list.toExercises: Rather fix broken networks? Go to the troubleshooting exercises
list.fromExercises: New: design a network from scratch for a customer

workspace.pinned: The customer's devices stay: you can move, cable and configure them, but not delete them.

brief.title: Brief
brief.howTo: Add network devices from the palette, cable them and configure them. The checklist is checked again a moment after each change.

checklist.title: Requirements
checklist.hidden: Acceptance test: revealed in the review
checklist.allMet: Every visible requirement is met. Submit the design to see the acceptance tests and your review.

spof.title: Single points of failure
spof.lead: Network devices whose failure alone breaks a requirement that works now.
spof.none: No single point of failure: no single network device can take a working requirement down.
spof.breaks: While it is down, these stop working:
